held.reason: Official US table publishes 10.3 / 9.8 oz without mapping those weights to a handle configuration. Do not pick one. The catalog CA3-5.5-LH row also prints a conflicting 5.1:1 ratio. Older A3- codes, 30-lb drag and 10.5-oz data are a different generation. Full exact-configuration resolution, material-labeled 12/240 capacity, and an image check remain required.

Only four exact Gen II codes were verified in the primary catalog table used here. Do not generate the other hand for each gear ratio, or add the older Concept C as a renamed C2. Additional exact-hand primary identity confirmation is needed.

Retailer listings differ between ING2-5.3 with 6.9 oz and 12/135 versus ING2P-5.3 with 7.2 oz and 12/150. Official announcement names a 5.3 power-handle version, but this batch did not reconcile non-P versus P identities, exact spool capacity and IPT. Do not treat spelling omissions as a newly discovered reel.

Same INSLD2 generation under two regional names, not two reels. Primary catalog confirms INSLD2-8.1-RH/LH and 0.32 mm/123 m but no pound-test capacity was verified from a suitable exact-model source in this pass. Held for the required pound-test validation; no strength inferred.

Primary catalog verifies MODC2-6.6/8.1 LH/RH, but a reliable exact-model pound-test/material and image evidence chain was not completed. Catalog 2024 gives 78 cm for 6.6 while 2026 gives 70 cm: preserve that discrepancy rather than silently borrowing another ratio's IPT.

held.model: Modus SZ2 F / Whisper Shallow Spool
held.reason: MODSZ2-8.1-RH-F/LH-F are distinct from included 7.3 standard spools. Primary catalog publishes 0.32 mm/61 m only; no verified exact published pound-test capacity in this pass. Never copy 12 lb/130 yd from the standard reel.

Primary catalog confirms MODTX2-7.3-RH/LH and 0.32 mm/123 m. A suitable exact-model pound-test/material confirmation and verified product-image chain were not completed. Not converted from diameter to lb.

The catalog's MODRP2-8.1-*-F shallow spool is 0.32 mm/61 m. Other Radioactive R2/RP2 marketing and standard-spool copy cannot establish that F model's pound-test capacity. No duplicate color, region or combo-only record generated.

Primary catalog lists exact model codes, but complete North-American exact-hand weight/capacity evidence and image verification were not completed. OF1-6.6-RH retailer explicitly labels mono 12 lb/110 yd, whereas other rows have weight and ratio transcription inconsistencies. Do not extend that one verified row to every Origin or use combo specifications for standalone records.

Official family announcement and retailer listing found; current official product detail was inaccessible and full exact-size IPT plus unambiguous material-labeled capacity evidence was not completed. No inferred size-to-weight/drag/IPT mapping.

Retailer table verifies six size/SKU combinations, but official exact-size table was unavailable. Full material-labeled capacity and IPT verification was not completed. Do not silently use conflicting retailer 5.2/6.2 ratios for the 5.0 size or copy specs from Kalon A/O.

These names describe the same O/Blackout family, not two discoveries. Official family/feature evidence exists but complete exact-size specifications, published pound-test/material labeling and images were not verified in this pass; combo-only versions excluded.

held.model: Axum original sizes 2.0 / 3.0 / 4.0 and Axum Competition
held.reason: Original AX 2.0/3.0/4.0 catalog rows are not promoted from diameter-only ratings without verified pound-test capacity. Concept A2.positioning: A low-profile, all-purpose casting family for bass and inshore lure fishing, with separate slower and faster retrieve options.
Concept A2.featureSentence: The six-way braking adjustment and accessible side plate let anglers tune casting control as lure loads change.
Concept A2.lineRangeNotes: Editorial starting ranges for the included standard-spool bass-casting variants; see editorialPolicy.lineRanges. Hand and gear-ratio changes do not establish different line-strength limits.

Concept C2.positioning: The lightweight Gen II Concept casting option for anglers making repeated lure presentations.
Concept C2.featureSentence: Its carbon frame and low-friction six-way brakes combine reduced reel weight with adjustable spool control during the cast.
Concept C2.lineRangeNotes: Editorial starting ranges for the included standard-spool bass-casting variants; see editorialPolicy.lineRanges. Hand and gear-ratio changes do not establish different line-strength limits.

Modus SZ2.positioning: An all-around casting reel spanning power and lighter lure presentations; these records cover the standard spool, not the separate shallow F version.
Modus SZ2.featureSentence: CZB spool bearings and six-way centrifugal braking are paired with an Arrowhead line guide to manage the spool and line during casting.
Modus SZ2.lineRangeNotes: Editorial starting ranges for the included standard-spool bass-casting variants; see editorialPolicy.lineRanges. Hand and gear-ratio changes do not establish different line-strength limits.

Inception G2.positioning: Gerald Swindle's versatile bass-casting series, offered in distinct gear and spool configurations.
Inception G2.featureSentence: The rapid-access side plate exposes the braking adjustment, making it possible to retune spool control when changing presentations.
Inception G2.lineRangeNotes: Editorial starting ranges for the included standard-spool bass-casting variants; see editorialPolicy.lineRanges. Hand and gear-ratio changes do not establish different line-strength limits.

Axum.positioning: The original Axum spinning family for inshore and freshwater use, with smaller and larger line-capacity options.
Axum.featureSentence: A ceramic line roller and Glide Oscillation handle line travel, while the sealed rotor is part of the reel's saltwater-oriented construction.

lineRanges.classification: Editorial synthesis for general bass casting; not a manufacturer recommendation for these exact reels.
lineRanges.scope: All four included families use standard spools with separately verified 12 lb mono capacity. That published reference is not a minimum/maximum line-strength limit and is not converted into a braid rating. No artificial range difference is assigned by hand or gear ratio.
lineRanges.guidance: Choose within or outside these starting ranges to suit the rod, lure, cover and intended technique. This baseline is not BFS, heavy punching or big-bait guidance; it does not claim a specific fill length, line diameter or drag setting. monoRange covers alternative mono or fluorocarbon main lines, not a new fluorocarbon capacity rating.

sourceEvidence.evidence: Rapala's surface-lure guidance gives 30 lb braid for open water and 40 or 50 lb around cover. Applying a 30-50 lb starting band to the included standard low-profile reels is editorial, not an exact-reel factory rating.
The Shad Rap section suggests 12-14 lb monofilament around timber, docks and abrasive cover. This supports part of the editorial mono range, not a spool-capacity claim.

The article describes 12-14 lb fluorocarbon for baitcasting soft plastics, 17 or 20 lb fluorocarbon around cover, and 17 lb mono for certain Texas-rigged plastics. The narrower 12-17 lb general starting band here is editorial synthesis.
